bullets: Replaced the web search provider with Ceramic, enforcing simple English keyword formats and rejecting complex characters.
Added lightweight iframe preview modes to the cloud browser, reserving full virtual desktops for complex web applications.
Fixed broken JSON formatting from AI models in tool calls to prevent sessions from abruptly stopping.
Updated AI instructions to report visual or user-interface changes as unverified if they were not checked after editing.
Added a specific notice for shared device allowance limits in the Freebuff model selector paywall.
Added a clear message when a free AI coding session expires, prompting users to send a message to start a new one.
Added Windows file path matching to the SDK to support cross-operating system file reads.
Added automatic scheme normalization for MCP server URLs pasted without a starting protocol.
Added a waiting-for-chat field to the run history to show which sibling chat a queued turn is waiting behind.
